message.hint: play “A button and a label” first

steps.text: Select **$root**, the top node of your scene.
Click **Attach Script**, keep the defaults, and press **Create**. The script editor opens; come back to the **2D** view afterwards.
steps.why: The code that reacts to the click will live in this script on **$root**.

target.tooltip: Attach a new or existing script to the selected node

steps.text: Next to the **Inspector** tab, open the **Signals** tab, then press **Next**.
steps.why: The Signals tab lists everything the selected node can announce, such as a Button's `pressed()`.

steps.text: Double-click **pressed()**, pick **$root** as the receiver, and press **Connect**.
steps.why: Connecting says: when $button is pressed, call a function on $root. Godot writes that function into the script for you.

steps.text: In the new function, replace `pass` with `$$message.text = "Clicked!"`, then press **Next**.
steps.why: `$$message` finds the label by name, and setting its `text` changes what it shows.

steps.text: Press **F6** to play, then click the button. The label should change to **Clicked!**
